title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
prompt:
Given an array `nums` of `n` integers where `1 <= nums[i] <= n`, return a list of all integers in the range `[1, n]` that do not appear in `nums`.

**Approach:** Index marking with O(1) extra space. Use the array itself as a hash map by negating values at visited indices.

**Requirements:**
1. Define and export `findDisappearedNumbers(nums: number[]): number[]` in `solution.ts`
2. First pass: for each number, mark the value at index `Math.abs(num) - 1` as negative
3. Second pass: collect all indices where the value is still positive -- those indices (+1) are the missing numbers
4. Return the array of missing numbers

**Examples:**
```typescript
findDisappearedNumbers([4, 3, 2, 7, 8, 2, 3, 1])  // [5, 6]
findDisappearedNumbers([1, 1])                      // [2]
findDisappearedNumbers([1])                          // []
```

**Complexity:** O(n) time, O(1) extra space (output array not counted)
hints: Since values are in [1, n], each value maps to a valid index (value - 1)
Use Math.abs(num) because a value might already be negated from an earlier step
Negate the value at the mapped index to mark it as seen
After marking, any index with a positive value was never visited

solution.ts.name: findDisappearedNumbers
solution.ts.description: Export findDisappearedNumbers as a named export
Iterate through the array with a for...of loop
Use Math.abs() to handle already-negated values
solution.ts.hint: Use Math.abs(num) - 1 to compute the index for marking
